cases.name: Samantha Teresa Quintanar
cases.about:
On her obituary, her little brother Marco Quintanar Jr. wrote: 
My Big Sister,
There isn't a day that goes by that I don't think about you or miss you every single day. I have picked up my phone 100 times to either call or text you and then remember you're not with us anymore. But my favorite memories are all of them because you had always made sure you were with us on every birthday or holiday because family meant everything to you. You mean the world to me sis. I also remember when I was little and you used to ask me to help you clean and I would say yes but then sit at the table while you put on music on our old computer dancing and making fun out of it. And you'd pick me up and I would join you and we just would be having the best time together. Thank you for making one of the biggest impacts on my life and watching and helping me become the man I am today. I love you so much Sammy, I will see you soon up with god.
Love,
Your lil bro Marco
cases.narrative: Sheriff discovered Samantha’s body covered with blankets and a bag covering her head. He had manually suffocated her to death with a green shopping bag.

cases.name: Samantha Teresa Quintanar-Lopez
cases.about: "She was our master of social work and head of our palliative care program which was a new program for us. And so she touched a lot of lives from the emergency department to our cancer center to our acute care center and really was instrumental in helping patients develop their advanced directive care plan," said Donna Hefner, CEO of Sierra View Hospital.
